diagnostics.message: aws_provider_config already depends on aws_provider through time_sleep.wait_30_seconds, whose depends_on includes aws_provider; the direct edge duplicates that ordering.

The Fluent Bit IRSA service account can be created before its namespace: both use the namespace input string, without an ordering edge. Make the service account depend on the managed namespace when namespace creation is enabled.
The service account uses a plain namespace input and can race creation of the namespace managed in the same IRSA module. Order it after kubernetes_namespace_v1.irsa.

When a non-kube-system namespace is configured and namespace creation is enabled, the service account can race its creation because metadata.namespace only references the input string. Order it after kubernetes_namespace_v1.irsa.

The EBS CSI add-on references the IRSA role ARN, but that output does not wait for role policy attachments. Order the add-on after the attachment so its controller does not start without its required AWS permissions.

The VPC CNI add-on references the IRSA role ARN, but that output does not wait for role policy attachments. Order the add-on after the attachment so aws-node does not start without its required EC2 permissions.
